title: Local rings under a ground field extension: faithful flatness and the residue field at a point of the base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a field extension K/k, a scheme X over k with Y = X_K, and a point y of Y over x in X, the four-part lemma describes the local map on local rings: it is faithfully flat, the residue field at y is the residue field of the kernel of the natural map kappa(x) tensor_k K to kappa(y), the local ring at y is a localization of the tensor product of the local ring at x with K, and the quotient by the maximal ideal of the local ring at x is the corresponding localization of kappa(x) tensor_k K (statement lines 237-253). The proof reduces to the affine case, where flatness is inherited from flatness of K over k and faithful flatness is then read off from the algebra lemma on local flat homomorphisms, and the residue field identification is quoted from the description of points of a fibre product (proof lines 255-261). The remaining two parts are proved by naming the relevant primes: the map of local rings factors through the tensor product with K localized at the contraction of the prime, and the second arrow is a localization at a prime that is the inverse image of the stated kernel (proof lines 262-279). Part (4) then follows by exactness of localization and of tensoring with K (proof lines 279-280). The claim is H2: a routine reduction with exactness bookkeeping, with no construction beyond identifying the relevant primes.
